items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: @USEmbassyNepal notes that Nepali authorities are reporting severe flooding in Rasuwa, with warnings for communities along the Bhote Koshi, Trishuli, and Narayani rivers. Families in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, Chitwan, or Tanahun are advised to stay clear of riverbanks and low-lying areas.

items.title: US Embassy Nepal
items.summary: The @USEmbassyNepal said they're saddened by the loss of life from the Bhote Koshi flood in Rasuwa district and are thinking of the families who are grieving.
